findings.function: getTokenPrice, getValidatedTokenPrice, getTokenAndGasPrices, getTokenPrices, onReport, convertTokenAmount, processMessageArgs, getValidatedFee (12 inlined '10 ** n' helpers)
findings.source: FeeQuoter._calculateRebasedValue / _getValidatedTokenPrice: 10 ** (36 - decimals) or 10 ** (decimals - 36) (solc's checked exponentiation helper)
findings.issue: The exponentiation helper's special cases stay visible: 'x == 36 or 10**(36 - x)' (10**0 is already 1) and 'e >= 78 and e >= 32' (the second test is implied), around the readable square-and-multiply loop.
findings.rule: 'x == c or 10**(c - x)' is 10**(c - x) (the power is 1 when x == c); 'e >= a and e >= b' is 'e >= max(a, b)' (same rule as c00290).

notes: All 30 ABI functions reviewed (getValidatedFee and processMessageArgs, ~300-500 lines, by structure; the configuration setters and getters line by line). The 17 source loops are all readable whiles: getTokenPrices (L280), _applyFeeTokensUpdates (L432, L437), updatePrices (L457, L466), _updateTokenPriceFeeds (L487), onReport (L509), _applyPremiumMultiplierWeiPerEthUpdates (L614), _getTokenTransferCost (L656), _applyTokenTransferFeeConfigUpdates (L795 with the nested L799, and L815), _processPoolReturnData (L953), _applyDestChainConfigUpdates (L1006), KeystoneFeedsPermissionHandler.setReportPermissions (L33), AuthorizedCallers._applyAuthorizedCallerUpdates (L49, L58). Implicit loops: 12 checked-exponentiation helpers ('while u > 1', readable), ~14 calldata decodes of struct arrays, 2 rotated zero-initialisations (P3), the bytes[] return encoding of processMessageArgs (a 'while True' with the return inside), 6 copy loops (P7). The selector of Client._argsToBytes' tag is printed in decimal (404606736). Struct members of returned configs are copied field by field as memory slices (P18). No semantic error found.
summary: Faithful and its 17 source loops are readable whiles; readability suffers only from the known patterns (keccak scratch stores, struct copies as memory slices, concat keys) and the exponentiation helper's leftover special cases.
